The [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] '''Class-C frigate''' was a military escort.

==Characteristics==
The Class-C was 330 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, and carried 20 [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and 200 crew. Its command center was located in the middle superstructure, while the [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] wings and engine section were in the sternward upper and lower sections, respectively.<ref name="POTGV2" />

==History==
The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] was produced by Kuat Drive Yards in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] latter days. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] they produced the first [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] line, a successor design to the Class-C.<ref name="OSAV38" />
The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]-defended [[Carosite]] medical frigate ''[[Sudden Restoration]]'' was a modified representative of this class.<ref name="POTGV2" />

==Behind the scenes==
As the only known representative of this class is the ''Sudden Restoration'', a vessel which had been modified to serve as a hospital ship, the original role and characteristics of the frigate are unknown.
